text.title: Agency Pricing Tiers Decision Tree
text.summary: Routing tree mapping observable pricing-sheet signals to a rule from 01-core-rules.xml. Every leaf references a rule id.

decision-tree.root-question: Does the agency know its delivery cost per deliverable (estimated hours × loaded hourly cost) and sell a repeatable service to a defined ICP?

conclusion.verdict: no cost basis, no margin rule; cost the service first
bespoke-only work is priced per proposal, not as tiers

branch.question: Are there exactly three priced tiers, each a strict superset of the one below, with quantities and turnaround listed?

conclusion.verdict: rebuild the ladder as three nested tiers before pricing

branch.question: Does the best tier carry the highest gross margin in absolute and percentage terms?

conclusion.verdict: strip or reprice best until its margin leads

branch.question: Do the prices sit within 15 percent of the 3 / 5 / 8 shape, with good fenced and better complete?

conclusion.verdict: reshape gaps or justify the deviation by a named scope difference
ladder is sound; write the scope-up procedure and publish best-first

text.example: delivery_cost_known=true -> repeatable_service=true -> three_nested_tiers=true -> best_margin_highest=true -> gaps_3_5_8=true -> conclusion ref=r-scope-up-procedure-documented
